instances.claim: This tells me that Chang initiated the process of redefinition because value had become decoupled from the object and indeterminate — that the artwork's instability of meaning was the condition he was responding to.
instances.why: Line 18 holds the decision expression ('Chang initiated'); lines 16 and 17 immediately precede it with properties of value — decoupled from the object, a vessel for social consensus, indeterminate and continually redefined — so the sequence offers them as what he was acting on. The only reason the draft states anywhere is at lines 1–2, 'a simple value discrepancy' between face value and copper, which is a different motive from the one this order supplies; and it also inverts the work's own logic, since the indeterminacy of lines 16–17 is presented elsewhere as a result of the five transformations rather than a prior state he answered.
